property_summary: After initialization, the buggy owner() always returns address(0) while the reference returns the original owner (this contract); a program operator (not the original owner) calls create() which calls onlyOwner-protected updateRoundImplementation (unrelated) — but the divergence manifests via the getter: calling c.owner() after setup returns zero in bug but non-zero in reference.
change_summary: Replace _owner with a constant address (address(0)) so that owner() always returns the zero address.
